project_type: React 18 SPA with Vite + TypeScript (strict) + Zustand state management + Supabase backend
build_system: Vite with npm; path alias @/ -> src/
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react, jsdom environment, globals enabled, setup in src/test-setup.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Run build: NODE_OPTIONS='' npm run build. 2. Run tests: NODE_OPTIONS='' npx vitest run. 3. Typecheck: NODE_OPTIONS='' npx tsc --noEmit
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network - npm registry available. NODE_OPTIONS must be cleared (NODE_OPTIONS='') before running node commands due to sandbox preload module issue.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode. All imports use @/ alias. Components follow pattern: ComponentDir/{ComponentName.tsx, index.ts, __tests__/}. Stores in src/stores/ with Zustand create(). Supabase mocked in tests via vi.mock('@/lib/supabase').
key_patterns: Components export from index.ts barrel files. Tests in __tests__ subdirectories. Stores use zustand create() with typed state+actions interfaces. Supabase auth via authStore which has signIn/signOut/subscribeToAuthChanges. Role extracted from JWT app_metadata.role. CanvasMode enum (DESIGNER/CONSULTANT) drives UI mode.
directory_structure: frontend/src/ contains: App.tsx (root component), main.tsx (entry), canvas/ (Konva canvas), components/ (UI panels), hooks/, lib/ (supabase client), stores/ (zustand), types/ (database.ts)
